p.s: Dear Kim,
Hi.
How do you do?
You may be asking why I haven't written to you before.
Well, I've been very busy you know.
Two weeks ago I enrolled in a group to help on building a stage for a concert of a famous singer star.
Activities lasting almost 2 days and a half.
The first day we have to move to the airport to bring all the equipment by lorries to the camp.
It was really awful and hard.
I finished the day too tired.
However, the second day was less heavier than the first one.
We just worked in building the stage and all those of thing.
Putting the instrument in the right place, testing all the microphone as well as the sound was the rest of the job.
At the end I must confess that it was really amazing hang up and down all the equipment which varied from small microphone to a marvellous huge large black screen of TV.
If you had this oportunitty one day, you had better buy the ticket to the concert or just watch it on TV but never do something like just to get a free pass.
My regards to your family.
Write me soon.
